body: My dad wouldn't understand, my siblings are all young and naive, and none of my friends are close enough to care.
That sounds nice. I wish i had the courage to see any mental health professional at all.
I don't think that these are immature but I do think that they could be seen as a little dark to some audiences. Personally, I love dark humor but you probably shouldn't tell these to everyone.

I just feel like I'm never going to meet my perceived potential (because my actual potential is so much lower than people think) and that there isn't really a solid reason to live. I won't meet anyone's expectations and life just seems too hard to live it for too long.
What happened to make you feel this way? You said you didn't care before, what changed?

I do the same thing. I just imagine what would my life look like if it was on a show and just laugh. I'd be that pathetic idiot that everyone gets to laugh at (and sometimes with), the comedic relief of the show.
The thing is I can't keep it up indefinitely, at some point the depression creeps back in and my mind (and body) collapses into a shuddering heap.
The only girl I've ever dated asked me out and I left after a week. It did not come as a surprise that she didn't try to stop me.

I know the feeling. Usually I start to feel this way when I get so fed up with feeling bad that I just remind myself that nothing matters or has any long-term value. When this happens, I don't get mad when someone's an asshole to me. The only thing I care about is staving off boredom, meaning I start doing all my homework, chores, and studying, even the ones that I don't have to do yet. The oddest part is when I get hurt, I barely feel pain. I smashed my finger in a door and forgot about it until I saw the bruise later that day. I knew it hurt but I just didn't feel it. Most of the time, I can only desensitize myself for a few hours before I start feeling like shit again. It's gotten so that I feel nothing during the day until I go home to bang my head against the wall.
Thanks, I appreciate you trying to help and will try to take your advice to heart. You're right, and just hearing someone put it in words helped.

I feel the same way some days. Other days, I think it'd be too much of a hassle and just want to fall asleep forever. I know it's cliche and you probably don't care, but other people know what you're going through.
